title: How to change the color of menu windows?

posts.author: Magenta-Fantasies
posts.body:
I'm trying to change the dark gray shade behind the menu options to purple to match the purple and yellow color scheme I use throughout the UI.
Here is an example with the menu plugins that I use (
Moghunter's menu plugins
and VisuStella Core, Skills and States Core and Elements and Status Core.) The dark gray stands out too much against the background I set, and I'd like to either change the color or even not have any color there at all.
Here is an example after I turned off all the plugins I use. Notice that the dark gray background persists, so it isn't a plugin issue.
This seems like something that should be easy to change, and at first it felt like a noobish question to ask.  However, after an hour or so of trying different things, I can't figure out how to change or remove that dark gray color. I didn't see anything under System settings or anywhere else that lets me change that part of the UI. Does anyone have any idea where in the settings that option is?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: I think the command backgrounds come from window selectable drawItemBackground which uses drawBackgroundRect. Change it for the windows menucommand and menustatus I think.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Here are a couple of different answers:
Skip drawing it:
Robro33 said:
save this as a .js file and add it into your project as a plugin at the bottom of the list
Code:
Window_ItemList.prototype.drawBackgroundRect = function(rect) {};
Click to expand...
Change its colour:
caethyril said:
These background rectangles appear in all of RMMZ's selectable windows and their colours do not reference the window skin:
caethyril said:
The selectable item background rectangles reference two colours from the
ColorManager
:
itemBackColor1
- upper gradient colour and rectangle border;
itemBackColor2
- lower gradient colour.
You can override these colours with a plugin that lets you configure the
ColorManager
, e.g.
VisuStella Core Engine
or my own
Cae_MenuDisplayOpts
~
Alternatively, you can put these methods in a .js file, edit the numbers, and import as a plugin:
JavaScript:
ColorManager.itemBackColor1 = function() {
    return "rgba(32, 32, 32, 0.5)";
};

ColorManager.itemBackColor2 = function() {
    return "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)";
};
If you want it totally transparent, try a value with 0 alpha, e.g.
rgba(0,0,0,0)
.

The second option worked! Thank you! I'm baffled that isn't something that is a hard-coded option within RPG Maker. It really feels like it should be.
My menu looks vastly better without those boxes. I still kept them on the Status page (to make it easier to read the text) using VisuStella Elements Core. I also made the outline on the type a little more pronounced with VisuStella Core. Now it's readable against the beige of the pages and also against purple backgrounds in other areas of the game.
If I had to nitpick something, I would have the character portraits on the right page, but that would be a massive pain to configure and I feel like there would be far too much empty space on the left page that way. I'm pretty satisfied with this new layout!

Ideally, I'd like to use Bell MT, which is a prettier but still very practical serif font, but I can't get it to work, even though it is a .ttf file and I have it in the Fonts folder. If I set it as the main font and load the game, I immediately get an error message saying it failed to load from the fonts folder, as well as a message saying the font failed to decode if I press F8. I made sure the name is typed correctly (which is easy to do, since it's just "bell.ttf") so I know it's not a typo.
